data.body: Implementation complete under held-out TDD. RED: 11 new behavior-contract failures with 127 neighboring passes. Separate standard-tier implementer saw only manifest/fingerprint happy paths; restored signed-record, tamper, malformed-token, material-transition, and recovery tests all passed (138/138) on first held-out run. Whole-HEAD fallback mutation made the none-scope signed-record test fail, then exact restoration passed. Fresh-context five-axis review approved with no findings. Exact gates: make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS (381 files); make test PASS (7339 passed, 29 skipped, 114 deselected).
